subject: Request: exec review — market-index clause + pricing safeguards for Acera Health
messages:
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.ai>
To: Deal Desk <deal-desk@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Cc: Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 12 Oct 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Request: exec review — market-index clause + pricing safeguards for Acera Health

Team — forwarding Acera’s latest redlines. They’re asking for a market-index clause (they want Redwood to track competitor published pricing and guarantee we won’t offer a lower public price to certain competitors) plus a 35% list discount floor for the first 24 months and a 12-month exclusivity carveout in two specific product lines.

Why this is tricky: the market-index wording effectively acts like an MFN/benchmark with public-pricing tie-ins; exclusivity + deep initial discount could limit our ability to route to cheaper infra or run limited promos. Customer is in pilot now and pushing hard for signature by EOW.

Attachments: Acera_Redlines_v3.docx (redlines), Acera_Term_Sheet_20261008.pdf (term sheet)

Asks:
- Legal / deal desk: risk assessment on the market-index wording (Marissa)
- Finance: revenue impact and discount guardrail suggestions (Jonas)
- Leadership: exec approval path if we propose a limited-duration compromise (Ben / Rishi / Laura)

Quick context: Sarah Nguyen (Head of Platform at Acera) has been our exec sponsor; they’re mid-stage, HIPAA-adjacent. They’ve signaled they’ll move budget if we accept these terms.

Thanks — I recommend we propose a counter that: (1) converts market-index to a bounded benchmarking clause (publicly-available published price comparisons only, with a 6-month lookback and opt-out on product promotions), (2) caps discount to 25% with an accelerant tied to committed spend, and (3) limits exclusivity to a 6-month voluntary pilot window for specific modules. Need rapid guidance so I can update Sarah today.

— Karthik Iyer
Account Executive, Americas
Redwood Inference
From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.ai>, Deal Desk <deal-desk@redwood.ai>
Cc: Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 12 Oct 2026 11:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Request: exec review — market-index clause + pricing safeguards for Acera Health

Karthik — thanks for the summary and attachments. Initial read: the proposed market-index language is broader than a standard MFN; it asks Redwood to monitor and mirror competitors’ public pricing and includes an undefined "index events" clause that could force retroactive credits.

Immediate legal asks:
- Replace any retroactivity language with prospective adjustments only.
- Remove requirement to track third-party private discounts; restrict to publicly posted list prices or published SaaS marketplaces only.
- Add a materiality threshold (e.g., price variance >10%) before any remedial action triggers.

On exclusivity: accept a pilot-limited exclusivity (max 90 days) but reject product-line-wide exclusivity or language that restricts our ability to pursue other customers.

I can produce redline suggestions. If leadership wants to accept a permanent MFN-like term we need exec sign-off and a mitigation plan (shorter term, higher price floor, termination right on data/contract breach).

— Marissa Cole
Senior Counsel, Commercial Contracts
Redwood Inference
From: Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.ai>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 12 Oct 2026 14:18:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Request: exec review — market-index clause + pricing safeguards for Acera Health

Karthik / Marissa — finance view: a 35% unconditioned floor for 24 months will materially reduce NPV for the deal at forecasted volumes. If they commit to $1.2M ARR in year one we still see a ~12% reduction in expected margin vs our model. Proposed alternatives:
- Cap initial discount to 25% but include a quarterly usage/commitment escalator that can unlock up to 35% if milestones are hit.
- If a benchmarking clause is non-negotiable, require it to be limited to publicly documented list prices and exclude promotional / marketplace offers, and cap any credit liability to X% of ARR (suggest cap = 10%).

Also incremental ask: require a 60-day termination right if public-market index changes drive >15% delta in price exposure.

Happy to run NPV scenarios if leadership wants to see tradeoffs.

— Jonas Weber
Director, Revenue Operations (Finance)
Redwood Inference
From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
To: Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 13 Oct 2026 09:07:00 -0700
Subject: Fwd: Request: exec review — market-index clause + pricing safeguards for Acera Health

Rishi / Laura — looping you in. Customer is strategic in healthcare vertical; pilot shows strong product fit. Sales would like to accept a narrowed benchmarking clause and a time-limited exclusivity if leadership signs off on the following guardrails:

1) Discount cap: 25% initial, unlock to 35% with $ committed milestones (Jonas to quantify).
2) Benchmarking limitation: public list pricing only; no retroactive credits; liability cap = 10% of first-year ARR.
3) Exclusivity: optional opt-in pilot for 90 days only and not automatic renewal.

If leadership approves these guardrails, we propose Marissa send the redline back today and I will confirm with Sarah. If leadership declines, we should propose a commercial alternative (e.g., longer pilot with product credits) to keep the deal moving.

— Ben Carter
VP Sales, Enterprise Accounts
Redwood Inference
From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai>
To: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 13 Oct 2026 15:30:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Fwd: Request: exec review — market-index clause + pricing safeguards for Acera Health

Thanks for the clear summary. I will approve a constrained compromise with the following mandatory guardrails: 
- Benchmarking limited to publicly posted list prices (no access to customer private contracts); no retroactive credits; any adjustment prospective only.
- Discount schedule as Ben/Jonas suggested: 25% floor with staged unlocks tied to documented committed spend milestones; do not exceed 35% unless CFO signs off.
- Exclusivity must be explicit opt-in for the customer and expire at 90 days; no product-line blocking language.
- Put a hard dollar cap on our total liability from price adjustments = 10% of year-one committed ARR.

Marissa: please prepare the contract redline (track changes) with the exact clause language reflecting the above. Jonas: prepare the ARR scenarios and put a conservative CFO-approved ceiling if they seek >35%. Ben / Karthik: aim to get Sarah to agree to commit numbers before we send final doc. I approve on the condition we get an explicit commitment to spend milestones in writing.

— Rishi Malhotra
Chief Revenue Officer (interim)
Redwood Inference
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.ai>
To: Sarah Nguyen <sarah@acerahealth.com>, Procurement <procure@acerahealth.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>, Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.ai>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 14 Oct 2026 16:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Request: exec review — market-index clause + pricing safeguards for Acera Health

Sarah / team — thanks for the productive conversation today. Per our internal review, Redwood can accept a bounded market-index benchmarking approach and the limited exclusivity pilot under these conditions: 

1) Benchmarking limited to publicly posted list prices (public website or published marketplace fees) only; no obligations to monitor private discounts or to provide retroactive credits. Any pricing adjustments are prospective and trigger only when variance >10%.
2) Discount schedule: 25% floor for the first quarter after signature with staged unlocks to a max of 35% tied to committed spend milestones (we will provide a milestone schedule — draft attached).
3) Exclusivity: optional opt-in pilot limited to 90 days for specific modules; customer must opt-in in writing.
4) Liability cap for price-related adjustments: 10% of year-one committed ARR.

Next steps: Marissa will send formal redlines to the term sheet and Jonas will attach a milestone schedule showing the unlock thresholds. If Acera confirms committed spend targets in writing we can proceed to signature.

Attachments: Acera_Redlines_v3.docx (updated redlines to follow from Marissa), Acera_Term_Sheet_20261008.pdf

Looking forward to closing this — Karthik will coordinate follow-up.

Best,
Karthik Iyer
Account Executive, Americas
Redwood Inference
